features.name: Title -> save-slot select -> first act
features.summary: Title and 5-slot data-select are inherited openSonicSMS objects. START launches global.selectedAct from chaos_acts(). No ROM 'new game' routine ($04D4 -> $2A1F/$2A00) is modelled; 'New Game' and 'Continue' are not distinct.

features.name: Natural act table covers all 18 acts
features.summary: chaos_acts() lists only THZ1-3. The 15 other acts exist only in chaos_debug_entries() (developer selector). chaos_act_index_for_room() returns 0 for GPZ/SEZ/MGHZ/AQZ/EEZ rooms, so chaos_act_complete() never advances saved progression there and chaos_act_clamp() clamps saved zoneGoto to 3.

features.name: Act-clear chain: type $18 sign -> $19 -> state $20 -> clear flag
features.summary: Sign contact, timer stop, hop, $19 child, state $20 run, EDGE(RIGHT,+33) clear flag. Boss acts converge on the same state $20 tail. Windows accepted in all six zones.

evidence.label: WIN-ACC
evidence.ref: AGENTS.md: all six ordinary zones accepted

features.name: Post-clear sequence: 198-frame wait, results screen ($32F9), tally ($2D08)
features.summary: Not implemented for ordinary acts. After the clear flag a non-debug session only draws a developer overlay ('ACT n COMPLETE!') and sits; it never changes room. Developer sessions return to the selector after 90 updates. The inherited OBJ_menu_point_counter is reachable only from legacy OBJ_plate and uses openSonic bonus tables, not ROM rules.

evidence.label: GAP
evidence.ref: SCR_chaos_goal.gml header lists results screen/tally/bonus as deferred

features.research_needed: RES-R0: ordinary results card graphics, ROM score-byte display scale ($27E2/$27E5), exact tally pacing/skip, per-zone card tables ($2D84/$32CA/$A3A0)

features.name: Next-act progression and zone rollover ($152F..$153E)
features.summary: Saved progression advances for THZ rooms only. No automatic room transition after clear. Canonical next-zone order is recorded in AGENTS/Research per boss audit (THZ3->GPZ1 ... GPZ3->MGHZ1, MGHZ3->AQZ1, AQZ3->EEZ1, EEZ3->ending) but no natural-order table exists in the POC.

features.name: Boss-act clear bonus ($0A param 0) and tally
features.summary: chaos_boss_bonus() computes packed BCD (time/ring) into global.chaosBossBonus and each boss clear computes global.chaosBossClearScore = ring*10+steps+500 (POC-side formula, not shown ROM-derived). Sparkle trail is accepted. Neither value is read: no tally, no score award.

features.name: Special Stage 1 entry (100 rings), play, results, return
features.summary: Shared ring-counter owner, +1 life wrap, 180-update entry, SS1 stage, $31 success, results cards, return to next ordinary act. Windows accepted at 3381cfd.

features.name: Special Stages 2-5
features.summary: SS2 is on an unaccepted local branch (not assessed per assignment). SS3-SS5 not started. Research package complete. chaos_ss_ring_counter_tick() deliberately skips entry whenever the selected stage is not SS1, so after SS1 success natural play never offers SS2+ (the full ending needs all five bits).

features.name: Emerald bits ($D2CC) and continues ($D2C3) carried through progression
features.summary: Held in RAM globals chaosCollectedFlags/chaosContinues (created lazily). Written by SS1 success, EEZ sixth bit, developer selector. Not saved/loaded (SCR_save_game persists the legacy 'chaoEmerald' variable instead). chaosContinues has no consumer.

features.name: Ending routes (full / partial) and common title return
features.summary: Both Sonic routes Windows accepted. Handoff reads chaosCollectedFlags & 63. Integration with a natural emerald source is unverified because SS2-SS5 are absent.

features.name: Title return then New Game reset ($2A00: bits, rings, score)
features.summary: OBJ_system (re-created by the title) resets life/score/ring and reloads the slot, but chaosCollectedFlags/chaosContinues are created only if absent and are never cleared. Bits earned in one run survive title return and would leak into the next run in the same process.

evidence.label: GAP
evidence.ref: grep: no assignment to chaosCollectedFlags/chaosContinues other than SS1, EEZ boss, debug selector

features.name: Developer-menu path vs genuine campaign path
features.summary: chaosDebugSession disables SCR_save_game and progression writes, returns to the selector 90 updates after clear, applies emerald masks and an SS1->THZ2 return adapter. Every accepted zone was accepted through this path; the natural path has only ever been exercised for THZ1-3 data-select START.

features.name: Life counter ownership and start value
features.summary: global.life (default 3, legacy openSonic) is the single POC owner: HUD OBJ_count_lifes, OBJ_player_death, ring-100 award. ROM start value and BCD cap behaviour at campaign start are not documented.
features.research_needed: RES-R0: ROM starting lives and new-game init values

features.name: 100-ring extra life with ring wrap, cap 99
features.summary: chaos_ss_ring_counter_tick(): subtract 100 per carry, life = min(99, life+1). Accepted at SS1 including +10 monitors/Large Rings. Inherited 'hundred' path in OBJ_count_rings is bypassed inside Chaos levels (returns early).

features.name: 1-UP via type $10 monitor (parameter $02)
features.summary: SCR_chaos_type10_reward() increments only the shadow variable global.chaosType10D299 (never read) and records request $A9. It never changes global.life, so a ROM 1-UP monitor gives no life and no HUD change. Research shows ring-100 ($3104) and parameter $02 execute the same BCD $D299 +1 / $A9 routine, so $D299 is the life counter. This is a confirmed extra-life ownership defect.

features.name: Goal-sign ring-count prize (classes: continue / 10 rings / 1-UP) and retry state 6
features.summary: Explicitly deferred in SCR_chaos_goal.gml. No prize is awarded in natural play. Research records tables $A919/$A962, class mapping and the retouch re-roll but flags class semantics and $D299/$D2C3 naming as provisional/conflicting.
features.research_needed: RES-R0: reconcile $D299 (lives) vs $D2C3 (continues); confirm class 1/3 effects; $19 panel graphics/digits

features.name: Score accumulation from enemies/monitors/SS
features.summary: global 'score' (legacy variable) gets +10 at several enemy sites, +100-point path for AQZ $3D, SS1 raw-unit tally (x10 display adapter). No central award function; no audit that every ROM score-table type awards. Bosses correctly award none.
features.research_needed: RES-R0: display scale of score bytes (listed UNRESOLVED in object-18-act-clear.md)

features.name: Score-threshold extra life
features.summary: No POC code and no Research statement either way. A bounded static check of the score-add routine ($262F) would settle whether the ROM awards lives at score thresholds.
features.research_needed: RES-R0: does $262F (or its callers) grant lives at score thresholds?

features.name: Death -> life loss -> act restart
features.summary: Inherited OBJ_player_death: life-1, ring=0, fade, room_restart if life>0. Not compared with ROM ($49B6 path) for what resets (timer, rings, checkpoint, powers) or for the 'lives left' off-by-one (3 start lives = 3 attempts here).

features.name: Game Over screen
features.summary: Inherited openSonic ROM_menu_game_over: legacy sprite for 90 updates then title. ROM zone-7 type $1F screen presentation and music $87 not extracted.
features.research_needed: RES-R1: Game Over / Continue screen presentation (zone 7 type $1F)

features.name: Continue (consume $D2C3, restore lives to 3, clear score, keep $D2CC)
features.summary: chaosContinues accrues from SS success and is drawn on the SS results card but nothing consumes it and no continue prompt exists. Semantics are documented (EMULATED); the prompt UI, countdown ($B4), accept ($A0) and music ($94) are only request-ID level.

features.name: 9:59 time-over rule
features.summary: Inherited OBJ_count_time kills at 9:59. The ROM time limit rule is not documented in Research.

features.name: Look up (state 3) incl. camera behaviour
features.summary: Corrects AGENTS ('not implemented'): the Chaos core already has states 3/4 (Up/Down held while still) and the adapter selects SPR_player_up/down. No camera look-shift code was found in the viewport/adapter scripts (static search, not exhaustive). Research knows setter $46B0 and attack-bit behaviour but has no camera-offset study.

evidence.label: WIN-ACC
evidence.ref: AGENTS.md says not implemented -> needs Windows check

features.research_needed: RES-R2: look up/down camera shift (delay, offset, speed, release) - bounded

features.name: Crouch / look down (state 4) and spin-dash charge entry
features.summary: State 4 -> state $0F (charge) -> $10 (roll) implemented in the core and exercised through accepted zones.

features.name: Super Peel-Out (states $15 charge / $1A run)
features.summary: No entry path in the POC: states 21/26 appear only as exclusions. Research has structural facts only: state numbers, setters $46CE/$46E2, attack-bit kept, aura object after a very long hold ('UNRESOLVED long hold'). Input combination, charge time, release speed table, animation frames, sound and aura are not extracted.
features.research_needed: RES-R3: Super Peel-Out state machine (input, $15/$1A callbacks, speed, frames, sound, aura)

features.name: Full Sonic state-script coverage vs POC core
features.summary: ROM has 61 Sonic state scripts. A literal-reference scan of SCR_chaos_core.gml finds 27 states never named ($00,$18,$19,$23,$24,$26,$27,$29-$3C). Some are plainly handled elsewhere (EEZ/ending/boss scripts) or unused; the scan is approximate. A one-day static state-coverage matrix would close this.

features.name: Player animation completeness
features.summary: Spring/airborne/fall/hurt animation scheduler is accepted. Anything else (idle wait animation, look/crouch frames fidelity, peel-out frames, skid, push, death variants) is not enumerated against the ROM animation scripts.

features.name: Isometric-platform fall presentation
features.summary: Observation only ('may require a different presentation'). Research isometric-platform audit exists; no study of the fall animation. Not a confirmed missing mechanic.

features.name: Shared hurt-landing extra vy=0 write
features.summary: Research confirmed the POC writes vy=0 on hurt landing where the ROM does not; classed a narrow shared-player task. Not shown fixed in accepted work.

features.name: Audio request ledger (70 IDs: 31 music, 37 SFX, 2 control)
features.summary: Accepted AUDIO-0. 24 music + 13 SFX + 2 control names verified, 31 numeric, 9 IDs without request sites.

features.name: Request-ID -> playback routing in POC
features.summary: Only chaos_debug_audio_asset() maps IDs: $A4,$A6,$BF (+$F8 stop). 39 sites record chaosLastSoundRequest (17 distinct IDs) but most never call the router. Inherited openSonic code plays its own SFX by asset name (jump, spin, spin-dash, break, spring, ring, life, score) independent of ROM IDs.

features.name: Music (31 IDs)
features.summary: sounds/ holds 21 assets, all inherited effects/stingers; zero music. Level, boss, SS ($8F/$8A/$86), ending ($8D/$9A/$98) and title ($82) music are intentionally silent today. Research parses streams but does not synthesise audio ('No PSG rendering').
features.research_needed: Strategy decision first (see unresolved Q6); then RES-R4 only if a ROM-driver playback path is chosen

features.name: Sound effects: ROM-ID fidelity
features.summary: Inherited openSonic effects cover many events (names SFX_ring, SFX_sonic_jump, ...). Provenance/accuracy versus SMS sounds is unverified; most ROM SFX IDs have no asset.

features.name: Fades, loops and transitions
features.summary: Ending fade events use recovered driver fields (accepted). Level/boss handoffs, 'no generic song-position stack', Silent Sneakers and clock timing are ledger facts with no runtime because there is no music engine.
